description: This file defines the SugarWebServiceImplv2_1 class, an extension of the core web service implementation for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, providing additional functionality for SOAP API interaction, specifically implementing the get_entry_list method to retrieve module data along with relationship data.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceImplv2_1
classes.description: A class extending SugarWebServiceImpl, implementing specialized web service methods for SuiteCRM version 2.1.

methods.name: get_entry_list
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of entries from a specified module, including relationship data, extending the base method from the parent class.
